recap.analyst:
Lombardia Nord and Montaña CF drew 0-0. On expected goals it finished 0.23–0.13: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Montaña CF had 55% of the ball. Pass completion LOM 75% (89/118), MON 82% (128/156). Shots 2–2, on target 0–0.

Lombardia Nord started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Montaña CF in a 5-4-1 (direct). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 91': From minute 91 Montaña CF's share of the threat (shots, chance quality, passing and high regains) jumped from 18% to 74% in five minutes: the spell when the game tilted their way.

By the numbers: B. Vladtek completed the most passes (31); R. Belruda hit the top speed (33 km/h); G. Inooka covered the most ground (4.3 km, a 12.3 km per-90 pace); D. Haldahl won the most challenges (10).

Discipline: fouls 4–7, yellows 0–2, offsides 0–0. Conditions: overcast, 27°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: Nobody could find the net at Arena Lombarda, Milan. Chances came and went at both ends, but the keepers had the final word. Montaña CF had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: D. Haldahl, with 7 completed passes and 10 tackles. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
